interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists by moving the waiting area past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to a high-visibility continental or ladder pattern to increase conspicuity.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and pedestrian crossing signage to formalize the crossing point, especially given the proximity to a bus stop.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown vegetation near the curb to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and ensure a smooth, accessible path.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees in the grass buffer to provide shade and naturally slow traffic through psychological narrowing of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Replace the cracked concrete slabs with a smooth, continuous walking surface to eliminate tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Add street trees within the grass buffer to provide shade and enhance the physical separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the right-of-way or underground them to clear the sidewalk of obstructions.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically slow vehicle traffic to safer residential speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions / Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Improved Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure lighting levels are adequate and consistent, particularly under the canopy of mature trees, to enhance nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly trim overhanging vegetation to maintain the full clear width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Add physical barriers such as bollards or a raised curb to separate the bike lane from the travel lane.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add vertical delineators or use the parking lane to provide physical separation for cyclists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Paint a high-visibility crosswalk to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to separate the walkway from the roadway.
